outcome: High dependency unit (HDU)/intensive care unit (ICU) stay
cohort: 64 singleton pregnant women beyond 20 weeks of gestation with preeclampsia and eclampsia presenting with neurological symptoms.
finding: Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) is associated with adverse fetomaternal outcomes in women with preeclampsia/eclampsia, including increased maternal and neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the PRES group.
